directions: Gut schütteln; aus 15-20 cm auf handtuchtrockenes Haar sprühen und föhnen; auch auf trockenem Haar möglich (vor heißen Geräten trocknen lassen).
formula_observations: Silicone-led (Trisiloxane 2nd, Dimethicone 3rd, Phenyl Trimethicone 5th, Dimethiconol 7th) with apricot kernel oil 4th and Cetyl PEG/PPG-10/1 Dimethicone emulsifier. Polyquaternium-16 (8th) is a cationic vinylpyrrolidone/vinylimidazolium styling-conditioning polymer - mild film former, not on the user's fixative list. No VP/VA, PVP, PQ-11, acrylates.
notes: PRIMARY PROMISE: heat protection + care/repair for long hair ('Styling und Pflege'). FIXATIVE: no classic fixative; PQ-16 at 8th is a borderline styling-conditioning polymer. OIL-LED: partly - apricot kernel oil 4th within a silicone-dominant system, so silicone-led rather than oil-led. RECOMMENDATION: stays Heat Protectant. Note the taft brand cue: same range as the Föhn-Spray (VP/VA fixative) but this sibling has none - shelf placement under 'Hitzeschutzspray & Co.' matches the formula here. This is the current DE taft heat spray on dm (taft x Gliss line); no other taft Hitzeschutz found.
